title: Crowdfunding for Grifters
subtitle: What are the data concerning scams in crowd funding?
text: The phenomenon of GoFundMe has allowed people with compelling stories, or who are just down on their luck, to raise money. This morning, I woke up to the (horrifying) realization that a person who has been harassing someone (*cough*) on the internet is now crowdfunding to pay for it! It got me thinking, what is the data behind fraud in crowd funding, …
